notes:
Account overview: LawMapper is a litigation support & compliance analytics vendor serving large law firms and corporate legal teams. Primary ask: robust RAG search over legacy document repositories with strict auditability and retention.

Key technical constraints / requirements:
- Indexing scale: ~50M documents initial, with growth expected to 200M+ over 2 years. Many docs are multi-part exhibits (large text + attachments).
- Embedding store: plan for ~500M vectors; concerned about vector storage cost and backup/restore time.
- Reranking: want two-phase pipeline — fast ANN recall (<=100ms) then model rerank (<=150ms end-to-end for top-K rerank). Targets: p99 query latency <250ms, typical SLA 150ms for interactive search.
- Throughput: baseline 200 qps during business hours; burst to 1k qps during discovery events.
- Cost sensitivity: target operational cost per query < $0.02 (avg), with monthly spend cap for initial contract.
- Retention & audit: 7+ year immutable retention, full audit logging per access, exportable chain-of-custody, redact-on-demand for PII, legal-hold features.
- Security: must support customer-managed KMS/HSM, SSO (SAML), VPC with private endpoints, and optional on-prem index replicas for air-gapped archives.

Quotes/notes from stakeholders:
- "We need immutable logs — every access must be auditable back to a user and API key." — Head of eDiscovery
- "If the vector store backup takes hours, our e-discovery timeline breaks. Need fast restore or snapshotting." — Platform lead

POC outline proposed by Redwood (from Diego):
- Phase 1: Ingest 5M sample docs, 25M vectors; validate embedding quality and index shard strategy. Measure recall/precision and rerank latency.
- Phase 2: Scale to 50M docs; run cost/latency analysis and test failover to fallback model variants.
- Phase 3: Hardening: KMS integration, audit log export, retention policy enforcement, and run legal-hold scenarios.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Detailed SLA for retention and immutable audit logs (format, export frequency).
- Exact network topology for private control-plane + data-plane (customer wants explicit flow diagrams).
- Pricing for snapshot/restore and long-term vector cold storage.

POC success criteria (customer):
- Demonstrated p99 query latency <=250ms on 50M doc workload for top-K retrieval + rerank;
- Rerank improves precision@10 by >=12% over baseline BM25;
- Verified audit logs that map requests to user IDs and persisted for 7 years;
- KMS/HSM envelope signing demonstrated in staging.
